wire.settings.hub_org.auto_enrol.help.note: 'subscribed' = they keep receiving the organization's updates. Same subscription vocabulary as wire.settings.hub_defaults.

wire.settings.hub_org.auto_enrol.label.note: Toggle: whether items the organization newly publishes (agents, teams, skills) are pulled to this machine automatically.

wire.settings.hub_org.auto_enrol.off.des.note: 'lop hub org pull' is a CLI command: keep it byte-identical, untranslated.

wire.settings.hub_org.auto_enrol.on.desc.note: Fragment shown beside the 'on' choice; follows the lowercase fragment style of the other hub choices.

wire.settings.hub_org.description.note: Shown only to Radient Team members. Never an upsell. 'private' = visible only to members of the organization. Applies immediately (live setting).

wire.settings.hub_org.title.note: Heading of a section shown ONLY to members of a Radient Team organization. 'Agent Hub' is the product name used in wire.settings.hub.title; keep it identical. 'Organization' = the user's company/team account, not a local team.
